decision: Required to start from the Pit Lane.
event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 35 Date 08 July 2018 Time 11:42 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 33), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Parts have been changed to those of a different specification whilst the car was under Parc Fermé conditions.
offence: Breach of Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start from the Pit Lane.
reason: As the parts are of a different specification to those used originally in qualifying the competitor is required to start from the pit lane and should follow the procedures laid out in Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The team notified the Technical Delegate of the change of parts/aerodynamic specification on Saturday 7th July, at 21:19. All
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
